title.en: Choosing TS features: enum, interface vs type, any

question.zh: TypeScript 里 enum、namespace 还用不用?interface 和 type 选哪个?什么时候可以用 any?
question.en: In TypeScript, should you still use enum and namespace? interface or type? When is any acceptable?

text.zh: 优先写「带类型的 JavaScript」:少用 enum、namespace 这类 TS 独有、会生成运行时代码的特性,用 as const 对象或字面量联合代替;interface 与 type 的选择他前后改过几次,2023 年后的结论是默认 type、需要组合对象时用 interface extends 而不是 &;any 不是绝对禁区,但要知道自己为什么用。
text.en: Prefer writing typed JavaScript: avoid TS-only features that generate runtime code, such as enum and namespace, and use as const objects or literal unions instead. His interface-versus-type advice changed a few times; since 2023 the conclusion is type by default, and interface extends rather than & when combining object types. any is not strictly off limits, but you should know why you are using it.

anchors.quote: you can only use type annotations, not TypeScript-only features.
anchors.quote_zh: 你只能用类型注解,不能用 TypeScript 独有的特性。

title.zh: 用三条启发式判断一个特性:所见即所得、可移植、听维护者的
title.en: Judge a feature with three heuristics: what you see is what you get, portable, listen to the maintainers

how.zh: 他给出的判断依据:写出来的代码要和输出的 JS 尽量一致,没有隐藏行为;代码要能在 Node 原生的「类型剥离」等环境里直接运行;维护者自己都抱怨的特性,就离远一点。enum 三条都不占优。
how.en: His criteria: the code you write should match the emitted JS as closely as possible, with no hidden behaviour; the code should run directly in environments such as Node's native type stripping; and keep away from features the maintainers themselves complain about. enum loses on all three.

anchors.quote: If the maintainers moan about a feature, stray away from it.
anchors.quote_zh: 如果维护者抱怨某个特性,就避开它。

title.zh: enum 换成 as const 对象或联合类型
title.en: Replace enum with an as const object or a union

how.zh: 需要一组命名常量时,用 as const 对象加派生出的联合类型;只需要值的集合时,Set 也是选项。需要每个成员带不同数据时,判别联合比 enum 更合适。唯一他会保留 enum 的场景是数值比较(例如日志级别大于 Debug)。
how.en: For a set of named constants, use an as const object plus a derived union type; for just a collection of values, a Set is also an option. When each member carries different data, a discriminated union fits better than an enum. The one case where he keeps enum is numeric comparison (a log level greater than Debug).

anchors.quote: how many of them are using 'as const' over enums.
anchors.quote_zh: 它们中很多都用 as const 代替 enum。

anchors.quote: So I swapped back to a discriminated union
anchors.quote_zh: 于是我换回了判别联合

anchors.quote: But in this situation, I'll choose the enum.
anchors.quote_zh: 但在这种情况下,我会选 enum。

how.zh: 运行时的 namespace 不再推荐;只做类型声明的 declare namespace(例如扩展 NodeJS.ProcessEnv)可以继续用。
how.en: Runtime namespaces are no longer recommended; declare namespace, which only declares types (for example extending NodeJS.ProcessEnv), is still fine.

title.zh: interface vs type:默认 type,组合对象用 interface extends
title.en: interface vs type: type by default, interface extends for combining objects

how.zh: 他的建议改过几次(见演变)。目前可执行的版本:日常默认用 type;需要把多个对象类型合并时,优先 interface extends 而不是交叉类型 &;注意 interface 的声明合并可能带来意外。
how.en: His advice changed several times (see how the view changed). The current working version: use type by default; when merging several object types, prefer interface extends over the intersection &; watch out for surprises from interface declaration merging.

anchors.quote: declaration merging should feel scary enough for you to default to 'type'.
anchors.quote_zh: 声明合并的风险应该足以让你默认使用 type。

title.zh: any:能用类型参数或 unknown 就别用;在库内部可以接受
title.en: any: avoid it when a type parameter or unknown works; acceptable inside libraries

how.zh: 函数参数写 any 时,先看能不能换成类型参数;外部数据(fetch、JSON.parse)用 unknown 接住再校验——他的 MIT 库 ts-reset 就是把这些返回值改成 unknown。库的内部实现里为了让使用者类型更好用而写 as any,他认为可以接受。
how.en: When a function parameter is any, first see whether a type parameter can replace it; catch outside data (fetch, JSON.parse) as unknown and validate it. His MIT library ts-reset changes those return values to unknown. Inside a library's implementation, writing as any to give users better types is acceptable in his view.

anchors.quote: Add a type parameter instead of the 'any', and everything just works.
anchors.quote_zh: 加一个类型参数代替 any,一切就都顺了。

anchors.quote: they'll return unknown across your entire project instead.
anchors.quote_zh: 它们会在整个项目里改为返回 unknown。

anchors.quote: TypeScript open source libraries: using 'as any' so you don't have to.
anchors.quote_zh: TypeScript 开源库:替你用了 as any。

title.zh: 本站示例:enum → as const 对象
title.en: Our example: enum to an as const object
ts-reset: make JSON.parse and fetch().json() return unknown

text.zh: 在会被 Node 原生类型剥离运行的代码里用 enum、运行时 namespace——它们不是纯类型语法,无法被直接剥离。
text.en: Using enum or runtime namespaces in code that Node runs with native type stripping: they are not pure type syntax and cannot simply be stripped.

text.zh: 把 any 当作绝对禁区或万能钥匙:两种极端都不对。
text.en: Treating any as strictly forbidden or as a master key: both extremes are wrong.

anchors.quote: Except, of course, it's never that simple
anchors.quote_zh: 当然,事情从来没那么简单

text.zh: 引用他 2022 年的 interface vs type 视频而不看 2025 年的更正。
text.en: Citing his 2022 interface vs type video without his 2025 correction.

anchors.quote: I needed to correct some things from my Types vs Interfaces video in 2022.
anchors.quote_zh: 我需要更正 2022 年那期 Types vs Interfaces 视频里的一些内容。

stance.zh: interface vs type:「随你喜欢」;开始推荐 as const 代替 enum。
stance.en: interface vs type: "whichever you like"; he starts recommending as const over enum.

anchors.quote: My new advice is 'use whatever you like'
anchors.quote_zh: 我的新建议是「随你喜欢」

stance.zh: 声明合并的风险足以让人默认 type;11 月总结为「选 type,组合选 extends」;承认 enum 在数值比较上有用。
stance.en: The risk of declaration merging is enough to default to type; in November he sums up as "choose type, extends for combining"; he grants enum is useful for numeric comparison.

stance.zh: Node 原生运行 TS 只支持可剥离的类型语法,进一步反对 enum 和运行时 namespace。
stance.en: Node runs TS natively but only supports strippable type syntax, a further case against enum and runtime namespaces.

stance.zh: 用三条启发式解释为何不喜欢 enum;更正 2022 年视频,认为关键是 & 与 interface extends 的对比,后者更好。
stance.en: He explains his dislike of enum with three heuristics and corrects the 2022 video: the real comparison is & versus interface extends, and the latter is better.
